hypotheses.justification: Only used to get (k.toNat:ℝ)=k via paperBohrIndex_cast_toNat. The statement holds for all integers k: only (k:ℝ) ≤ k.toNat is needed (Int.self_le_toNat). With j ≥ k.toNat+1, the goal is j - kt - 1/2 ≤ |k+τ-j|, and |k+τ-j| ≥ j-k-τ ≥ j-kt-τ > j-kt-1/2 since τ<1/2. For k<0, kt=0 and it is still true (e.g. k=-5,j=1,τ=.3: 1/2 ≤ 5.7). Neither N nor 100 ≤ N is needed. Can be dropped alone or together with hk.

Only used for the cast equation (k.toNat:ℝ)=k. The inequality is true for every integer k, using just (k:ℝ) ≤ k.toNat (Int.self_le_toNat) and the bound |x| ≥ -x with τ < 1/2; the case k ≤ 0 (kt = 0) is also fine. Can be dropped alone or together with hN (N would then no longer appear in the statement, but it is an implicit argument and could be removed too).
